environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' with a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*--)|(?:%27|%2527)` with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in COUNT mode (monitoring phase). The custom rule group has capacity 50 WCU and is the only rule in BLOCK mode. CloudWatch metrics namespace 'corp/waf' tracks BlockedRequests. The ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with 5-minute intervals.
